trends.name: Iran Conflict Escalates Oil Markets
trends.summary: Israel launched fresh attacks on Iran March 20 despite Trump's warnings, with Saudi Arabia warning oil could spike past $180/barrel if disruptions persist through late April. Iran now charging $2M+ per tanker for Strait of Hormuz passage, fundamentally altering energy geopolitics and forcing alternative route discussions. Market volatility expected as oil supply chain risks multiply.

trends.name: Central Bank Rate Cut Expectations Shift
trends.summary: ECB signaling two baseline rate hikes while BoE expected to deliver cuts starting November 2026, marking a divergence in monetary policy. ECB's Makhlouf emphasized action if facts warrant, suggesting hawkish stance may persist longer than previously expected. This divergence creates currency and bond market implications across major economies.

trends.name: Super Micro Chip Smuggling Scandal
trends.summary: Super Micro shares tanked 25% after co-founder charged with running backdoor scheme to divert Nvidia chips to China. U.S. government enforcement signals serious supply chain security concerns and geopolitical tech tensions. Major implications for semiconductor supply chains and China-US tech decoupling.

trends.name: Big Tech CapEx Overinvestment Concerns
trends.summary: 22% of global fund managers now believe Big Tech is deploying excessive CapEx, the second-highest reading on record. Only February 2026 showed higher skepticism at 33%, signaling growing investor concerns about AI infrastructure deployment returns. This threatens mega-cap valuations if capex efficiency questioned.

trends.name: Private Credit Market Liquidity Crisis
trends.summary: Private credit money is rushing for exits, indicating emerging liquidity concerns in alternative credit markets. With $2+ trillion in private credit assets, redemption pressures could cascade into broader credit markets. Signals potential financing stress for leveraged companies and middle-market borrowers.

trends.name: Crypto Regulatory Framework Under Pressure
trends.summary: Crypto firms seeking banking perks without regulatory rules, creating 2008-level systemic risks. As financial advisors warm to Bitcoin, lack of oversight in stablecoin and custody frameworks poses contagion risk. Regulatory crackdown likely as risks crystallize.

trends.name: Luxury Sector Earnings & Brand Resilience
trends.summary: Ferrari's luxury flywheel remains intact with 'Luce' brand test critical for decade; Ermenegildo Zegna Q4 results analyzed; Prudential showing growth potential. Luxury stocks bifurcating on execution risk, with heritage brands tested by macro headwinds and Chinese demand softness.

trends.name: USD/JPY Currency Volatility & BoJ Hawkishness
trends.summary: BoJ hawkish pivot driving yen strength with USD/JPY technical levels at 157.40 critical; ECB and BoE also tightening expectations. Divergent rate paths across major central banks creating significant FX volatility with implications for carry trades and emerging market funding.

trends.name: Oil & Energy Market Mean Reversion Trade
trends.summary: Oil trading above $100 signals mean reversion opportunity while extreme weather (triple-digit temperatures) straining energy demand. IEA recommending work-from-home and reduced driving to manage supply shocks. Seasonal demand patterns intersecting with geopolitical disruption creating trading volatility.

trends.name: Healthcare Cost Crisis & Consumer Pressure
trends.summary: Soaring healthcare costs forcing consumers to skip meals and make troubling trade-offs; situation worsening ahead. Rising healthcare burden reducing discretionary spending and consumer purchasing power. Structural inflationary pressure on households with policy implications for healthcare stocks and consumer companies.

trends.name: New Zealand Credit Downgrade Signal
trends.summary: Fitch revised New Zealand's outlook to negative while affirming AA+ rating, signaling medium-term credit concerns. Reflects broader developed market fiscal and structural pressures. May indicate rating agency scrutiny expanding beyond major economies.

trends.name: Trump Geopolitical Risk & Gulf Arms Sales
trends.summary: Trump invoking emergency powers for $23 billion Gulf arms sales while planning potentially risky Kharg Island takeover to force Iran concessions. Escalating military commitments and unprecedented intervention rhetoric creating unpredictable geopolitical premium in markets. Taiwan and North Korea implications uncertain.
